Approved with comments. This change adds a CLAUDE.md that documents the standard command workflow, but it references a `make bundle` target that does not exist in this repo's Makefile — a real defect worth fixing before it misleads an agent or developer. Nothing here risks production, so a single corrected command resolves it.

🤖 Generated with Claude

comments.body:
🟡 **MODERATE:** `make bundle` is not a real target. This repo's Makefile has no `bundle` target — the distributable is built by `make build` (which runs `uv build`). Anyone following this doc gets `make: *** No rule to make target 'bundle'.  Stop.` Note the same stale command is repeated on line 12 ("Run `make bundle` before every release"); fix that reference too.

```suggestion
make build     # build the distributable package
```
